notes.zh:
### v0.4.0

- 记忆系统重构：治理型 SQLite 结构化存储（移除向量记忆），支持原子修订、审计日志、备份恢复与旧数据迁移
- 精简 ReAct 内核：调用账本（CallLedger）、计划/步骤验收、结构化回执与证据分级、检查点与超时防护
- core + library 架构拆分：tools / ledger / memory 提为顶级包
- 功能裁剪：移除 CLI Apps 生态、web_search / deep_research / image_generation 工具子包及 OAuth 死代码
- IM 适配器与 OpenAI 兼容服务拆分为可选 extras
- 项目更名 MiniUnicorn → Erza：包名 erza-ai、CLI 命令 erza、环境变量前缀 ERZA_*、数据目录 ~/.erza（破坏性变更，请查阅迁移说明）
notes.en:
### v0.4.0

- Memory rework: governed SQLite structured storage (vector memory removed) with atomic revisions, audit journals, backup/restore and legacy migration
- Lean ReAct kernel: call ledger (CallLedger), plan/step acceptance, structured receipts with evidence levels, checkpoints and timeout guards
- core + library split: tools / ledger / memory promoted to top-level packages
- Feature strip: CLI Apps ecosystem, web_search / deep_research / image_generation tool subpackages and OAuth dead code removed
- IM adapters and the OpenAI-compatible server are now optional extras
- Project renamed MiniUnicorn → Erza: package erza-ai, CLI command erza, env prefix ERZA_*, data dir ~/.erza (breaking — see migration notes)
